h1: AI and machine learning, *from model to running system.*
answer: Machine learning builds models that learn from data to predict, classify or recognise patterns, and modern AI adds language models that read and write. Techlio builds both kinds of system and the engineering around them: data preparation, evaluation, serving, monitoring and retraining.

builds.title: Language-model applications
builds.text: Agents, retrieval systems and generative features built on current models.

builds.title: Computer vision
builds.text: Models that analyse images and video, served through an application people can use.

builds.title: Prediction and classification
builds.text: Models trained on your data for scoring, routing and forecasting.

fits: You have data and a decision that is made repeatedly
A general language model alone does not solve the problem
You need the model in production, not only in a notebook

faqs.question: Do we need a custom model?
faqs.answer: Often not. A current language model with good retrieval solves many problems. We recommend custom training only when it clearly performs better or costs less.

faqs.question: How much data do we need?
faqs.answer: It depends on the task. The assessment at the start tells you whether your data is enough.

faqs.question: How do you know the model is good?
faqs.answer: Against a held-out test set and agreed metrics before launch, and by monitoring in production afterwards.
